prompt: Let $f(x) = 2x + 3$. The machine spits out $19$. What input went in?
hint: The machine does two things in order. To find the input, undo them starting with the one done last.

hints.text: The machine does two things in order. To find the input, undo them starting with the one done last.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Simpler: $2x + 3 = 9$ gives $2x = 6$, so $x = 3$. Undo in reverse: subtract the $3$, then divide by the $2$.
Solve $2x + 3 = 19$: subtract $3$ to get $2x = 16$, then undo the "times $2$" by dividing.
$16 \div 2 = 8$, so the input that went in was $8$.

explanation: The output is $19$, so set the rule equal to it: $2x + 3 = 19$.
Undo the "plus $3$" first by subtracting $3$ from both sides: $2x = 16$.
Undo the "times $2$" by dividing both sides by $2$: $x = 8$, so the input was $8$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check with the table
steps: Try $f(7) = 17$ and $f(9) = 21$ — the output $19$ sits between them.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ Dodge the trap
steps: Running 19 forward — 2(19) + 3 = 41 — uses the machine in the wrong direction.
Walk backwards through the machine, last step first: 19 − 3 = 16, then 16 ÷ 2 = 8.
